steps.en: Build and install MLT with the FFmpeg development libraries present
steps.zh: 备好 FFmpeg 开发库，编译安装 MLT

steps.en: Line up the clips and put a 25-frame luma transition between them
steps.zh: 排好片段，中间加一段 25 帧的亮度转场

steps.en: Point the output at an encoder instead of the preview window
steps.zh: 把输出指向编码器，而不是预览窗口

steps.en: Producers decode each clip through FFmpeg and normalise it to one profile
steps.zh: 生产者经 FFmpeg 解码每个片段，统一到同一套参数

steps.en: Pulls frames in timeline order, applying filters and blending the transition
steps.zh: 按时间线顺序取帧，套滤镜、混合转场

steps.en: The consumer encodes the finished frames into the output file
steps.zh: 消费者把成品帧编码写进输出文件

value.en: A multitrack edit becomes a repeatable command or MLT XML file, rendered frame-accurately without writing a timeline engine
value.zh: 多轨剪辑变成一条可重复的命令或一份 MLT XML，按帧精确渲染，不用自己写时间线引擎

sources: https://www.mltframework.org/docs/melt/ (melt clip1.dv clip2.dv -mix 25 -mixer luma; -consumer avformat:output.avi acodec=libmp3lame vcodec=libx264; producers normalised to the profile; xml consumer)
https://www.mltframework.org/docs/framework/ (producers, consumers, playlist/tractor services; C API mlt_factory_producer / mlt_consumer_start)
